nina-ui: Quick alignment thread: proposing final routing conventions for the sidebar regroup experiment. Top-level sections: Author (Models, Datasets), Serve (Endpoints, Rollouts), Observe (Metrics, Logs). Key decisions to lock: canonical URL shape for subviews, behavior when incoming URL targets collapsed nav groups, and accessibility focus rules on deep link landings.

omar-engineering: Strong preference for hierarchical path segments for page identity: e.g. `/console/models/:id`, `/console/models/:id/deployments`, `/console/models/:id/versions/:vid`. Keep query params for filters only (`?q=` or `?since=`). Implementation: generate routes from nav config and emit a small mapping table {pattern -> navGroupKey} so left-nav highlight is deterministic without brittle string matching.

leah-px: Copy rules: left nav should use singular nouns (Model, Dataset), list pages show plurals (Models, Datasets). H1s should be friendly: "Model details" rather than terse single words. Breadcrumbs: e.g., "Models › ResNet-XL › Deployments" and each crumb must link to a canonical route. Also change any internal "master" text to "primary".

dustin-sre: Redirecting legacy `?tab=` links: prefer server-side 301s for bots and crawlers, fallback to client redirect for browsers. Important: capture the raw incoming URL (including query and hash) in telemetry before redirect so attribution and experiments are accurate. On client redirect use `history.replaceState` to avoid polluting history and to suppress duplicate fetches.

nina-ui: UX edge cases: if a shared URL targets a nested item but the user's sidebar group is collapsed, auto-expand that group on load but do not persistently change the user's collapse preference. Auto-expand should be visually obvious (small motion) and we must not move keyboard focus into the nav; focus should land on the page H1.

omar-engineering: Hash anchors (e.g., `/models/12#perf`) — handle client-side only. SSR should return the canonical path without the hash; after hydration the client smooth-scrolls to the anchor. Also server-render minimal OG/meta for canonical routes so links shared externally show useful previews (title + short summary).

leah-px: Accessibility checklist: 1) On route change focus goes to H1; 2) Provide a visible skip-to-content link; 3) `aria-expanded` on nav groups and `aria-current="page"` on active leaf; 4) Announce route changes with `aria-live="polite"` (short only); 5) When auto-expanding, do not trap focus or forcibly move it into the nav.

dustin-sre: Performance note: where possible resolve canonical path server-side and render final page to avoid double data fetches. If client must redirect, do a quick redirect + replaceState and suppress the second fetch in the router. Also include `Link: <canonical-url>; rel="canonical"` header for bots.

nav-helper-bot: PR opened: `design/nav-conventions` -> reviewers requested: @nina-ui @omar-engineering. CI: lint + a11y smoke.

nina-ui: I'll update the IA mocks with exact path examples, breadcrumb copy suggestions, and a two-column mapping doc showing legacy `?tab=` -> new canonical routes. Will attach a one-paragraph a11y checklist for eng in the PR. Thanks all! :wave:
